Interface EDPServerActionAsync

  • All Superinterfaces:
    EDPMessageSource, EDPProgressMessageSource
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    EDPEditorAsync, EDPQueryAsync, EDPSessionAsync

    public interface EDPServerActionAsync
extends EDPMessageSource, EDPProgressMessageSource
    This interface gives access to common server action EDP commands. See online help.
